title: Top K Frequent Values
commonMistakes: Returning values in first-occurrence order instead of ascending numeric order
Breaking a frequency tie in favor of the larger value
Using the array index as the value when building the frequency map
Assuming the output should list the most frequent value first
followUps: How would a min-heap of size k change the complexity?
Can bucket sort by frequency produce an O(n) solution?
How would you handle a stream where k changes for each query?
